name: triage
label: Triage: which images a grader should read first, and why
description: Reads the relay's output for one visit (the masks, with every image's confidence and measurements) and decides the reading order: images below the confidence cutoff, or failing the modality's plausibility check (for OCT: retina found), are read first, hard failures and the least confident first. It gives the visit a reading priority, 1 to 3 (for OCT: priority 1 when a flagged B-scan crosses the central 1-mm circle where CST is measured, or the scan is decentred) and writes a checklist per image, each line with where to look. Signals (layer order, continuity between neighbouring B-scans) are reported and never change a verdict or the priority; image quality and change since the last visit are recorded as 'na'. Every image is still read; only the order changes. The gear contains no model.
author: Kaan
cite: Score + cutoff routing: Domalpally et al., Ophthalmol Sci 2022;2:100198. OCT rules pre-registered in analysis/prereg/phase_a.md (+ Amendment 1). Thickness ILM to top of RPE and the 200 um decentration limit: Pak et al., IOVS 2013;54:4512-8.

relay_output.description: The relay gear's output (<name>_relay.nrrd): the label volume, 'spacings' in mm in the header, and every image's answer in the header field 'relay'. Label 255 = image not acquired.

continuity_limits.description: Optional JSON of continuity limits learned from graders' tracings (analysis/phase_a.py writes continuity_limits.json: Garvin 2009 mean +- 2.6 SD). Without it, continuity is recorded as 'na'.

confidence_threshold.description: Images with confidence at or above this go to the routine queue; below it they are read first. The Youden cutoff on 1,672 out-of-fold OCT5k B-scans for model unet_w32_cv5_ez_border, unrounded (per-fold cutoffs 0.9870-0.9876); rounding it down would pass scans the analysis reads first. Re-derive it for any other model.

cutoff_model.description: The model the cutoff was chosen for. The job fails if the relay's answers come from another model, because another model's scores need their own cutoff (analysis/gate_analysis.py derives one).

min_retina_fraction.description: OCT plausibility check: the mask must show retina (any layer band) in at least this fraction of image columns, or the B-scan is read first whatever its confidence. All 5,016 OCT5k human gradings are at or above 0.949.

modality.description: Which modality module judges the images. Today: OCT retinal layers.

tag_prefix.description: The input file is tagged <prefix>1, 2 or 3.
